['run the check_structure function to validate markdown API docs have correct section ordering and required sections', 'run the check_examples function to verify every C++ example file is referenced in at least one markdown file', 'run the check_links function to detect duplicate file entries in the mkdocs.yml navigation', 'run the script as a CLI to lint all API markdown files for structure, examples, and navigation issues', 'review the report function that tracks and prints numbered warnings with rule tags for documentation linting']
